tasks.title: Review AWS core services and architecture concepts
tasks.description: Study AWS core services (EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, etc.) and architecture best practices to build a strong foundation for the exam.
tasks.done_criteria: Complete a self-assessment quiz on AWS core services and architecture concepts with a score of at least 80%.

tasks.title: Practice exam 1: Focus on core services and design concepts
tasks.description: Take the first full-length practice exam focusing on core AWS services and architecture design principles.
tasks.done_criteria: Complete the practice exam and record the score (target: 55% to 65%).

tasks.title: Review weak areas and study additional materials
tasks.description: Identify weak areas from the first practice exam and study additional materials (whitepapers, documentation, and practice questions) to improve understanding.
tasks.done_criteria: Complete a second self-assessment quiz on weak areas with a score of at least 85%.

tasks.title: Practice exam 2: Focus on advanced topics and real-world scenarios
tasks.description: Take the second full-length practice exam focusing on advanced topics and real-world AWS architecture scenarios.
tasks.done_criteria: Complete the practice exam and record the score (target: 70% to 80%).

tasks.title: Final review and targeted practice
tasks.description: Review key concepts, focus on weak areas, and take targeted practice questions to ensure readiness for the exam.
tasks.done_criteria: Complete a final self-assessment quiz with a score of at least 85%.

tasks.title: Research and select 4 relevant AWS labs
tasks.description: Identify and select 4 hands-on AWS labs that align with the Solutions Architect – Associate certification topics. Ensure the labs are from reputable sources such as AWS Training, AWS Whitepapers, or official AWS documentation.
tasks.done_criteria: A list of 4 selected AWS labs is documented and shared with the team or personal notes.

tasks.title: Complete first AWS lab and document the process
tasks.description: Work through the first selected AWS lab, document the steps taken, any challenges faced, and the final outcome. Ensure the documentation is clear and ready for version control.
tasks.done_criteria: A complete documentation of the first lab is saved in a Git repository and is ready for review.

tasks.title: Complete second AWS lab and document the process
tasks.description: Work through the second selected AWS lab, document the steps taken, any challenges faced, and the final outcome. Ensure the documentation is clear and ready for version control.
tasks.done_criteria: A complete documentation of the second lab is saved in a Git repository and is ready for review.

tasks.title: Complete third AWS lab and document the process
tasks.description: Work through the third selected AWS lab, document the steps taken, any challenges faced, and the final outcome. Ensure the documentation is clear and ready for version control.
tasks.done_criteria: A complete documentation of the third lab is saved in a Git repository and is ready for review.

tasks.title: Complete fourth AWS lab and document the process
tasks.description: Work through the fourth selected AWS lab, document the steps taken, any challenges faced, and the final outcome. Ensure the documentation is clear and ready for version control.
tasks.done_criteria: A complete documentation of the fourth lab is saved in a Git repository and is ready for review.

tasks.title: Publish all labs in a public Git repository
tasks.description: Push all lab documentation to a public Git repository, ensuring it is organized, accessible, and properly labeled for clarity.
tasks.done_criteria: All 4 lab documents are published in a public Git repository and are accessible to others.

tasks.title: Research and select AWS certification study materials
tasks.description: Identify and select a comprehensive study plan, including official AWS training resources, practice exams, and supplementary materials.
tasks.done_criteria: A study plan with selected resources and a schedule is documented and shared with the team or self-reviewed for completeness and relevance.

tasks.title: Complete practice exams and track progress
tasks.description: Take full-length practice exams to assess knowledge and identify areas needing improvement, aiming to raise the score from 55% to 80%.
tasks.done_criteria: A record of completed practice exams and score improvements is maintained, with the final score reaching 80% or higher.

tasks.title: Complete AWS labs and publish to public Git repository
tasks.description: Complete 4 hands-on AWS labs, document the work, and publish the results in a public Git repository for review.
tasks.done_criteria: A public Git repository with 4 completed AWS labs and clear documentation is published and accessible.

tasks.title: Book and sit for the AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate exam
tasks.description: Book the official AWS exam by the deadline (2026-12-15) and prepare for it using the study plan and practice exams.
tasks.done_criteria: The exam is booked and scheduled by 2026-12-15, and the candidate is ready to take it.
